prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Tennessine (Ts) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a string-instrument workshop of her element's kingdom — unfinished banjos and fiddles hanging from the beams, wood shavings, clamps and a window over the river landing
Time of day: an overcast day — soft, shadowless grey-white light; soft even light, colours calm, no hard shadows.
Outfit: an instrument maker look fitted to her body — a low-cut blouse with rolled sleeves, a short leather apron over a short skirt and buttoned boots, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing at a work surface, upper body leaning slightly forward over it, hips back and weight on both feet.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she holds an unfinished banjo in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
EXPRESSION: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened.
Scene note: she is the instrument maker stretching a new head over a banjo rim at her bench

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — tennessine: a synthetic superheavy element, the heaviest in the halogen column, first made in 2010 by firing calcium ions at a target of berkelium, twenty-two milligrams of it cooked for about two hundred and fifty days in a research reactor across the ocean; racing the target's own decay, the sealed shipment was turned back at customs twice for missing papers and crossed the ocean five times; named for a land of winding rivers, blue-hazed mountains and string-band music where its makers worked; though its name ends like fluorine, chlorine, bromine, iodine and astatine, it is predicted to grasp least of all its kin, closer to a metal than a true halogen — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: petite, small-framed — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
